value.title: DANNY CHRISTIAN (SPEAKEAZY)
value.description:
Special Saturday evening performance by Danny Christian.

Join us in our hidden speakeazy for an evening of great music and handcrafted cocktails as Danny Christian takes the stage. Hailing from Northeast Ohio, Danny brings a smooth, engaging sound that pairs perfectly with an intimate night out.
🍸
Settle in with a delicious drink, enjoy a few small bites, and let the music set the mood in our cozy, tucked-away lounge. Whether you're planning a date night, meeting friends, or just looking for a unique night out, the speakeazy is the perfect place to unwind. 

This free show has limited seating and happens on August 1st from 7-10pm 
Only at The Workz
2220 Front St.
Cuyahoga Falls, Ohio

value.title: COUNTRY LINE DANCING
value.description:
Whether you have two left feet or you’re a seasoned pro, come join us for a night of rhythm and fun at The Workz 
.
We’re breaking the mold with a line dancing event that features music from every genre—from all the traditional favorites, and famous country line dance songs 
.
6:00 PM - 7:00 PM: 
(The Tutorial.) Our instructor Shannon Welfley will walk you through the steps so you can feel confident on the floor. Perfect for beginners or those needing a refresher!
.
7:00 PM - 9:00 PM:
(The Dance Party)
Two full hours of non-stop dancing to your favorite beats.
.
Bring the whole family—this is an all-ages, FREE event! August 6th!! 6-9pm, only at The Workz-2220 Front St. Cuyahoga Falls, Ohio

value.description:

they’ll be taking over the main stage on August 29th from 8-11pm 🎶 Get ready to groove to your favorite dance hits from the last five decades!

value.title: SALSA
value.description:
Summer is going strong and The Workz bringing the HEAT and the SALSA💃🏽

(Due to the large interest.. please plan to arrive early as our salsa nights fill up quickly)

Get ready to move your feet and feel the rhythm! Join us for an exciting Salsa Dancing Night filled with music, movement, and fun for everyone.
💃
Friday August 21st from 8pm-11pm
8-9pm: instructor led class
9-11pm: dance party 
Whether you're a complete beginner or a seasoned salsa dancer, this is your night to shine! No partner or experience needed—just bring your energy and come ready to dance.

✨ Free Entry | All Ages Welcome

Come solo, bring a friend, or make new ones on the dance floor. Let’s spice up the night with the joy of salsa!

2220 Front Street 
Cuyahoga Falls Ohio

value.title: SB MUSIC
value.description:
Get ready to rock with SB Music! Based in Wooster, this 5-piece band brings years of experience to the stage, delivering high-energy hits focused mainly on 80s and 90s classic rock, plus favorites from the 60s, 70s, and country-rock.
.
This free show kicks off at 8pm on August 28th ! Only at The Workz—2220 Front Street Cuyahoga Falls, Ohio

value.title: 90 PROOF
value.description:
Get ready to relive the 90s with Northeast Ohio’s premier alternative/pop-rock cover band, 90 Proof! 
They’ve made a name for themselves by bringing high-energy performances of all your favorite 90s hits—from Foo Fighters and Pearl Jam to Green Day and Goo Goo Dolls. 
.
Expect sing-alongs, infectious hooks, and a setlist loaded with nostalgia.
This is definitely a show you don’t want to miss!! 
August 15th 8-11pm!!
Only at The Workz
2220 Front St Cuyahoga Falls, Ohio

📣 Step back in time and join us for a roaring good time at our 1920s themed Prohibition Party! 🎩🍸 Get ready to immerse yourself in the glitz and glamour of the Jazz Age, as we transport you to an era filled with secret speakeasies and hidden delights. ✨🎷 For just $15 per person, you'll be treated to a 75 minute experience sampling of our amazing snacks that are sure to tickle your taste buds. 🍢🥪 But that's not all! We've got live music that will have you dancing the  Charleston, and to top it off, our signature Espresso Martinis are 50% off throughout the experience. ☕🍸 Whether you're looking for a fun date night out or simply want to experience the magic of the 1920s, we've got you covered. Choose from three different time slots on April 4th and secure your spot at this unforgettable event. 🗓️🌃 So grab your flapper dresses and fedoras, and let's party like it's the Prohibition era! 🥂🎉 Don't miss out on this opportunity to step into the past and create memories that will last a lifetime. See you there! 🎶🍾
value.title: Prohibition Party

value.description: Nightmare on Front Street is the signature fundraising event hosted and benefitting the DTCF Partnership, a 501C3 non-profit organization. This 5-hour Halloween inspired event is taking place on the plaza, amphitheater, and within the pavilion in downtown Cuyahoga Falls featuring Ohio breweries, wine, live entertainment, market vendors, food trucks, haunted history, costume contests, prizes, and more! It is an indoor and outdoor event in the heart of our downtown.
value.title: Nightmare on Front Street
